utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around this courtroom. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-06-90-T, the Prosecutor versus Gotovina et al. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. It was my mistake that we didn't move into open session yesterday before adjourning, which is usually done. Therefore, the public could not have known that we would continue this morning. This doesn't change anything as far as continuing in closed session is concerned. Therefore, we have to move back into closed session, because we hear the evidence of the present witness in closed session, reasons to be put on the record at a later stage.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. I'd like to thank all those who have assisted us and who have shown great flexibility in allowing the afternoon session and thereby allowing the witness to return as soon as possible. We adjourn, and we will resume on Monday, the 19th of April of this year, at 9.00 in the morning, Courtroom III.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 19th day of April, 2010, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 4.25 p.m.,
